1: # Contract: AL-6 Chronological Event Extraction and Schema Evolution in Go
2: 
3: ## 1. Problem Statement
4: Active session telemetry in AgenticLens is generated and backfilled natively by the Go engine across backend/cmd/agentic-lens, backend/internal/adapters/opencode, and backend/internal/adapters/backfill. While workspace ledgers (agentic_metrics.json) are already at schema version 2 with migration metadata, they record only coarse aggregate numbers per invocation and overall tool execution and error counts.
5: 
6: Detecting fine-grained execution anomalies (such as consecutive tool failure streaks, subagent rework loops, and single-turn context window spikes planned in AL-7, AL-8, and AL-9) requires ordered, turn-level event telemetry.
7: 
8: Furthermore, existing workspaces on disk (under workspaces/) currently lack this ordered chronological event stream. To prevent fleet telemetry fragmentation, the new chronological event extraction must not only serve future sessions, but must also be actively backfilled across all existing workspaces where sessions exist in the OpenCode SQLite database.
9: 
10: Ticket AL-6 delivers native Go chronological event extraction, schema evolution, and workspace backfill:
11: 1. Defines pure domain event models (EventFact) representing atomic turn events, tool executions, and compaction milestones.
12: 2. Updates OpenCode SQLite extraction in backend/internal/adapters/opencode/extractor.go to extract, correlate, and chronologically sort events from session, message, and part tables.
13: 3. Provides seamless bidirectional serialization and backward compatibility in backend/internal/adapters/schemas.go and backend/internal/adapters/repository.go, ensuring historical ledgers lacking events deserialize cleanly without regression.
14: 4. Integrates event capture into both agentic-lens generate and agentic-lens backfill --recompute-db.
15: 5. Backfills existing workspaces on disk to populate chronological events from local OpenCode SQLite session traces.
16: 6. Establishes TypeScript domain contract parity in web/src/domain/types.ts.
17: 
18: ---
19: 
20: ## 2. Functional Core, Imperative Shell (FCIS) Invariants
21: 
22: All implementation must strictly comply with architectural boundaries established in TECHNICAL_GUIDELINES.md:
23: 
24: ### Inward Dependency Flow
25: Dependencies flow strictly inward across layers:
26: 1. CLI Subcommand Layer (backend/cmd/agentic-lens/main.go):
27:    - Application entrypoint, CLI flag parsing (generate, backfill, server), console output rendering, and adapter wiring.
28: 2. Imperative Adapters Layer (backend/internal/adapters/):
29:    - External boundary serialization and DTO mapping (backend/internal/adapters/schemas.go).
30:    - Filesystem workspace traversal and raw ledger reading (backend/internal/adapters/repository.go).
31:    - SQLite read-only queries and extraction from OpenCode database (backend/internal/adapters/opencode/).
32:    - Multi-workspace backfill coordination (backend/internal/adapters/backfill/).
33: 3. Functional Core Domain Layer (backend/internal/domain/):
34:    - Houses pure domain models (EventFact, AgenticFactLedger, AgenticMetricsLedger), typed event enums (EventType), and pure aggregation algorithms.
35:    - Must contain zero disk I/O, zero network calls, zero SQL queries, and zero system clocks. All timestamps, durations, and external identifiers must be passed as arguments from the imperative shell.
36: 
37: ### Pure Domain Core Isolation
38: 1. EventType is defined as a typed string enum in backend/internal/domain/enums.go with explicit constants for tool calls, turn messages, and compactions.
39: 2. EventFact is an immutable domain value object capturing timestamp, session identifier, turn index, agent role, event type, optional tool name, execution status, optional error message, optional duration in milliseconds, and context token count.
40: 3. Adding Events []EventFact to AgenticFactLedger in backend

1: # Implementation Plan: AL-6 Chronological Event Extraction and Schema Evolution in Go
2: 
3: ## 1. Goal and Iteration Scope
4: Deliver chronological event extraction, schema evolution, and existing workspace backfill natively in Go across domain core, boundary adapters, SQLite extractor, CLI commands, and TypeScript frontend type contracts. This enables fine-grained event telemetry extraction from OpenCode SQLite databases into agentic_metrics.json, maintains complete backward compatibility with existing ledgers that omit events, and upgrades historical workspace ledgers on disk with populated event streams.
5: 
6: ---
7: 
8: ## 2. Grounded Reference Architecture and Concrete Paths
9: 
10: The implementation maps to the following existing files and packages:
11: 
12: ### Domain Core Layer (backend/internal/domain/)
13: - backend/internal/domain/enums.go: Add EventType string enum type and typed constants (EventTypeToolCall, EventTypeTurnMessage, EventTypeCompaction).
14: - backend/internal/domain/models.go: Add EventFact struct. Add optional Events []EventFact to AgenticFactLedger.
15: - backend/internal/domain/aggregations.go: Verify pure aggregation functions preserve Events without regression.
16: 
17: ### Boundary Adapters Layer (backend/internal/adapters/)
18: - backend/internal/adapters/schemas.go: Add EventFactDTO struct with bidirectional mapping to domain.EventFact. Update AgenticFactLedgerDTO with Events []EventFactDTO (json tag events,omitempty).
19: - backend/internal/adapters/repository.go: Update ExistingLedgerFacts and rawExistingLedger to parse and hold Events. Ensure safe decoding when events is absent.
20: - backend/internal/adapters/opencode/extractor.go: Extend extraction logic to query messages and parts, construct EventFact slices, correlate turn numbers and context tokens, detect tool errors, compute execution duration, and sort events chronologically.
21: - backend/internal/adapters/backfill/engine.go: Wire extracted events into processSingleWorkspace when --recompute-db is executed, ensure ledgers lacking events are candidate targets for recompute, and preserve non-destructive facts when local sessions are absent.
22: 
23: ### CLI Application Layer (backend/cmd/agentic-lens/)
24: - backend/cmd/agentic-lens/main.go: Update runGenerate to receive extracted events from opencode.ExtractFacts, cache existing events if SQLite is not queried, and persist events in AgenticFactLedger. Ensure backfill subcommand runs smoothly for batch workspace updates.
25: 
26: ### TypeScript Presentation Layer (web/src/domain/)
27: - web/src/domain/types.ts: Define EventFact interface with readonly fields matching domain models. Add optional readonly events?: readonly EventFact[]; to AgenticFactLedger.
28: 
29: ### Test Suites
30: - backend/internal/adapters/opencode/extractor_test.go: Unit and adversarial tests for chronological event extraction, tool error detection, compaction correlation, and sorting.
31: - backend/internal/adapters/repository_test.go: Backward compatibility tests loading ledgers without events, and round-trip tests with events.
32: - backend/internal/adapters/backfill/engine_test.go: Backfill tests asserting event population on database match and preservation on database miss.
33: - backend/cmd/agentic-lens/main_test.go: CLI integration tests for generate and backfill with event emission.
34: 
35: ---
36: 
37: ## 3. Phased Implementation Tasks
38: 
39: ### Phase 1: Domain Core Models and Event Types (backend/internal/domain/)
40: - Task 1.1: Define EventType string enum type in backend/internal/domain/enums.go:
41:   - Constant EventTypeToolCall = "tool_call"
42:   - Constant EventTypeTurnMessage = "turn_message"
43:   - Constant EventTypeCompaction = "compaction"
44: - Task 1.2: Define EventFact struct in backend/internal/domain/models.go:
45:   - Field Timestamp of type string with JSON tag timestamp
46:   - Field SessionID of type string with JSON tag session_id
47:   - F
